data.name: Qasim
data.gender_notes: Qasim is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ق-س-م (q-s-m), 'to divide, distribute'. Qāsim means 'divider'. Its root is ق-س-م (q-s-m). Borne by Qāsim, a son of the Prophet ﷺ. Qasim is a Arabic name meaning “Divider; distributor”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Qasim expresses “Divider; distributor”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ق-س-م (q-s-m), 'to divide, distribute'. Qāsim means 'divider'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qasim total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

Qasim is a Arabic name meaning “Divider; distributor”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
